raw.source: US BIS - Department of Commerce Rescinds Biden-Era Firearms Rule, Restoring Common Sense to Export Controls on Civilian Firearms
raw.content_en: BIS has rescinded the Biden-era firearms export rule, easing licensing and classification treatment for civilian firearms and ammunition under the Export Administration Regulations. Exporters of civilian firearms, parts, and ammunition to the US market should re-verify ECCN classification and license exceptions, confirm US HTS alignment for the 10-digit tariff line, and screen all parties against BIS Entity List and restricted party lists. Section 301 tariff exposure and FCC requirements (where electronic sights or accessories are involved) still apply. Retain end-use and end-user documentation to support the restored civilian-firearms treatment.
raw.content_zh: 美国商务部工业与安全局（BIS）撤销了拜登时期的枪支出口规则，放宽了民用枪支及弹药在《出口管理条例》下的许可与分类处理。向美国市场出口民用枪支、零部件及弹药的企业应重新核实ECCN分类与许可例外，确认美国HTS十位税则号对齐，并对所有交易方进行BIS实体清单及受限方名单筛查。第301条关税风险及FCC要求（涉及电子瞄具或配件时）仍然适用。应保留最终用途与最终用户文件，以支持恢复后的民用枪支待遇。

checklist.desc: Re-classify civilian firearms, parts, and ammunition under the rescinded rule; confirm ECCN and any applicable license exception before shipment.
For electronic sights, optics, or accessories, confirm FCC Part 15/18 conformity and supplier FCC IDs.
Map the 10-digit HTS line, check Section 301 list exposure, and document country of origin and value build-up.

checklist.task: BIS Entity List & restricted party screening
checklist.desc: Screen all parties against BIS Entity List, OFAC, and denied party lists; retain screening records.
Obtain and retain end-user and end-use certificates supporting civilian firearms treatment under the restored rule.
Where electronic components are included, verify RoHS and REACH obligations for the US-bound product line.
